claims.content: To define and enforce security settings for the entire system by allocating roles to user groups with specific permissions (Edit, Delete, View, Print) and mandatory information capture (Group Code, Group Name).

goal.raw_text: To define and enforce security settings for the entire system by allocating roles to user groups with specific permissions (Edit, Delete, View, Print) and mandatory information capture (Group Code, Group Name).

claims.content: System Administrator
The system admin only can able to create User Groups
The security setting of the entire system is based on User Group
The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new User Group to define security settings and permissions.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new User Group to define security settings and permissions.

claims.content: The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new User Group.
The system prompts for mandatory master part information: Group Code and Group Name.
The System Administrator enters the transaction part information, specifying the Screen Name.
The System Administrator defines permissions for the specified screen by selecting 'Allowed' or 'Not Allowed' for actions including New, Edit, Delete, View, and Print.
The system validates that all mandatory information has been entered.
The system checks to ensure the User Group name does not already exist.
The system saves the User Group configuration with the defined security settings and permissions.
If the System Administrator attempts to create a User Group with an existing name, the system does not allow the creation.
If any of the mandatory information (Group Code, Group Name, Screen Name, or permission settings) is missing during entry, the system requires the information to be provided before proceeding.
If the System Administrator attempts to create a User Group with an existing name, the system does not allow the creation.
If any of the mandatory information (Group Code, Group Name, Screen Name, or permission settings) is missing during entry, the system requires the information to be provided before proceeding.
A new User Group is successfully created with unique Group Code and Group Name.
Security settings for the system are established based on the newly created User Group, with roles allocated to it.
Permissions (Edit, Delete, View, Print) for specific screens are defined and enforced as 'Allowed' or 'Not Allowed' for the User Group.
All mandatory information including Group Code, Group Name, Screen Name, and permission settings are saved in the system.
The system prevents creation of duplicate User Group names, ensuring uniqueness of group identifiers.
